meta.title: Moment Of Hunting
meta.description: Shadow after shadow hunts the scattered light.

units.rawText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: The High Order Entropic called Antenora has a smug smile on her face, as though Eos and I are flies caught in her web.
units.displayText: The High Order Entropic called Antenora has a smug smile on her face, as though Eos and I are flies caught in her web.

spans.text: The High Order Entropic called Antenora has a smug smile on her face, as though Eos and I are flies caught in her web.

units.rawText: Both Eos and I are keenly aware that we have stepped into a trap, and one that has been carefully prepared by a High Order Entropic.
units.displayText: Both Eos and I are keenly aware that we have stepped into a trap, and one that has been carefully prepared by a High Order Entropic.

spans.text: Both Eos and I are keenly aware that we have stepped into a trap, and one that has been carefully prepared by a High Order Entropic.

units.rawText: Let's go!
units.displayText: Let's go!

spans.text: Let's go!

units.rawText: Eos attacks almost simultaneously with my words. The ray of operands directed at Antenora creates a brief opening for us, and we withdraw towards the exit.
units.displayText: Eos attacks almost simultaneously with my words. The ray of operands directed at Antenora creates a brief opening for us, and we withdraw towards the exit.

spans.text: Eos attacks almost simultaneously with my words. The ray of operands directed at Antenora creates a brief opening for us, and we withdraw towards the exit.

units.rawText: Teeheehee, why are you so eager to leave? Are you unhappy with this snare that I've set?
units.displayText: Teeheehee, why are you so eager to leave? Are you unhappy with this snare that I've set?

spans.text: Teeheehee, why are you so eager to leave? Are you unhappy with this snare that I've set?

units.rawText: A terrifying figure stands in the direction where the exit should have been. We turn back reflexively, and in place of Antenora is the passage by which we entered the tower.
units.displayText: A terrifying figure stands in the direction where the exit should have been. We turn back reflexively, and in place of Antenora is the passage by which we entered the tower.

spans.text: A terrifying figure stands in the direction where the exit should have been. We turn back reflexively, and in place of Antenora is the passage by which we entered the tower.

units.rawText: (Are there two exits... Or...)
units.displayText: Are there two exits... Or...

spans.text: Are there two exits... Or...

units.rawText: What's wrong? Are you Sanctifiers all the silent type?
units.displayText: What's wrong? Are you Sanctifiers all the silent type?

spans.text: What's wrong? Are you Sanctifiers all the silent type?

options.rawText: Distracting us with a fake Watchtower is hardly in good taste.
options.displayText: Distracting us with a fake Watchtower is hardly in good taste.

spans.text: Distracting us with a fake Watchtower is hardly in good taste.

options.rawText: Is this part of your trap, too?
options.displayText: Is this part of your trap, too?

spans.text: Is this part of your trap, too?

units.rawText: Hm~ It's just like the info said. No wonder Ptolemaea cares so much about you... You're arranging for your friend to break out even as you try to pump me for information.
units.displayText: Hm~ It's just like the info said. No wonder Ptolemaea cares so much about you... You're arranging for your friend to break out even as you try to pump me for information.

spans.text: Hm~ It's just like the info said. No wonder Ptolemaea cares so much about you... You're arranging for your friend to break out even as you try to pump me for information.

units.rawText: The movement in the air hits me before her blade does. Just as Antenora cleaves down on me with her sharp forelimbs, a transparent barrier deploys as Eos interposes herself in front of me.
units.displayText: The movement in the air hits me before her blade does. Just as Antenora cleaves down on me with her sharp forelimbs, a transparent barrier deploys as Eos interposes herself in front of me.

spans.text: The movement in the air hits me before her blade does. Just as Antenora cleaves down on me with her sharp forelimbs, a transparent barrier deploys as Eos interposes herself in front of me.

units.rawText: And then we have you, the most emotive of all Sanctifiers. Surely your heroic intervention will expose a weakness in you...
units.displayText: And then we have you, the most emotive of all Sanctifiers. Surely your heroic intervention will expose a weakness in you...

spans.text: And then we have you, the most emotive of all Sanctifiers. Surely your heroic intervention will expose a weakness in you...

units.rawText: <size=40>Eos, look out!</size>
units.displayText: Eos, look out!

spans.text: Eos, look out!

units.rawText: An eerie sensation fills me and I instinctively run up, putting my arms around Eos and throwing us both aside.
units.displayText: An eerie sensation fills me and I instinctively run up, putting my arms around Eos and throwing us both aside.

spans.text: An eerie sensation fills me and I instinctively run up, putting my arms around Eos and throwing us both aside.

units.rawText: Boom—
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: An Entropizing blast hits the place where we were standing a moment ago, and the stone at our former location begins to slowly melt away.
units.displayText: An Entropizing blast hits the place where we were standing a moment ago, and the stone at our former location begins to slowly melt away.

spans.text: An Entropizing blast hits the place where we were standing a moment ago, and the stone at our former location begins to slowly melt away.

units.rawText: Whew... Thank you, <cmdr>...
units.displayText: Whew... Thank you, {교수}...

spans.text: Whew... Thank you,

units.rawText: It's okay, but it seems like this Entropic knows us very well... We can't get caught up in fighting her, we need to complete our mission first.
units.displayText: It's okay, but it seems like this Entropic knows us very well... We can't get caught up in fighting her, we need to complete our mission first.

spans.text: It's okay, but it seems like this Entropic knows us very well... We can't get caught up in fighting her, we need to complete our mission first.

units.rawText: We turn and head for the exit, but we end up running into Antenora again, while the exit appears behind us like before.
units.displayText: We turn and head for the exit, but we end up running into Antenora again, while the exit appears behind us like before.

spans.text: We turn and head for the exit, but we end up running into Antenora again, while the exit appears behind us like before.

units.rawText: ...Looks like the entire trap is under her control.
units.displayText: ...Looks like the entire trap is under her control.

spans.text: ...Looks like the entire trap is under her control.

units.rawText: Clapclapclap—
units.displayText: Clapclapclap—

spans.text: Clapclapclap—

units.rawText: Antenora looks at us with a playful glint in her eye as she applauds.
units.displayText: Antenora looks at us with a playful glint in her eye as she applauds.

spans.text: Antenora looks at us with a playful glint in her eye as she applauds.

units.rawText: Mmm, well done. As expected of Eosphorus' left and right hands; both of you are still quite calm...
units.displayText: Mmm, well done. As expected of Eosphorus' left and right hands; both of you are still quite calm...

spans.text: Mmm, well done. As expected of Eosphorus' left and right hands; both of you are still quite calm...

units.rawText: Still, don't you think you're being a little TOO arrogant by discussing how you'll escape your huntress when she's right in front of you?
units.displayText: Still, don't you think you're being a little TOO arrogant by discussing how you'll escape your huntress when she's right in front of you?

spans.text: Still, don't you think you're being a little TOO arrogant by discussing how you'll escape your huntress when she's right in front of you?

units.rawText: Antenora's voice suddenly appears behind us, accompanied by the sound of something sharp slicing through the air.
units.displayText: Antenora's voice suddenly appears behind us, accompanied by the sound of something sharp slicing through the air.

spans.text: Antenora's voice suddenly appears behind us, accompanied by the sound of something sharp slicing through the air.

units.rawText: (Winces)
units.displayText: Winces

spans.text: Winces

units.rawText: Eos' reflexively-erected defense cannot stop Antenora's carefully-aimed attack, and the razor-sharp blade-leg pierces Eos' arm. However, it does not hinder her movements.
units.displayText: Eos' reflexively-erected defense cannot stop Antenora's carefully-aimed attack, and the razor-sharp blade-leg pierces Eos' arm. However, it does not hinder her movements.

spans.text: Eos' reflexively-erected defense cannot stop Antenora's carefully-aimed attack, and the razor-sharp blade-leg pierces Eos' arm. However, it does not hinder her movements.

units.rawText: Eos, 1 o'clock!
units.displayText: Eos, 1 o'clock!

spans.text: Eos, 1 o'clock!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: The operands gathered in Eos' hand turn into starlight that lunges out at Antenora.
units.displayText: The operands gathered in Eos' hand turn into starlight that lunges out at Antenora.

spans.text: The operands gathered in Eos' hand turn into starlight that lunges out at Antenora.

units.rawText: What a shame, you missed.
units.displayText: What a shame, you missed.

spans.text: What a shame, you missed.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Cannon fire from inside the fake tower crashes against Eos' defenses, forcing her to take a few steps back.
units.displayText: Cannon fire from inside the fake tower crashes against Eos' defenses, forcing her to take a few steps back.

spans.text: Cannon fire from inside the fake tower crashes against Eos' defenses, forcing her to take a few steps back.

units.rawText: Antenora descends from the ceiling once again, eying us hungrily with a mirthful look in her eyes.
units.displayText: Antenora descends from the ceiling once again, eying us hungrily with a mirthful look in her eyes.

spans.text: Antenora descends from the ceiling once again, eying us hungrily with a mirthful look in her eyes.

units.rawText: Spider webs... and a fake tower whose terrain you can change?
units.displayText: Spider webs... and a fake tower whose terrain you can change?

spans.text: Spider webs... and a fake tower whose terrain you can change?

units.rawText: Bingo. Too bad you don't get a prize for that.
units.displayText: Bingo. Too bad you don't get a prize for that.

spans.text: Bingo. Too bad you don't get a prize for that.

units.rawText: In the next moment, Antenora's voice speaks from behind us.
units.displayText: In the next moment, Antenora's voice speaks from behind us.

spans.text: In the next moment, Antenora's voice speaks from behind us.

units.rawText: <cmdr>... Can you analyze the patterns of this trap?
units.displayText: {교수}... Can you analyze the patterns of this trap?

spans.text: ... Can you analyze the patterns of this trap?

units.rawText: I don't have enough information...
units.displayText: I don't have enough information...

spans.text: I don't have enough information...

units.rawText: Got it. I'll create an opportunity.
units.displayText: Got it. I'll create an opportunity.

spans.text: Got it. I'll create an opportunity.

units.rawText: Be careful.
units.displayText: Be careful.

spans.text: Be careful.

units.rawText: Eos nods and light begins gathering around Eos. Stellar radiance fills our surroundings.
units.displayText: Eos nods and light begins gathering around Eos. Stellar radiance fills our surroundings.

spans.text: Eos nods and light begins gathering around Eos. Stellar radiance fills our surroundings.

units.rawText: The struggles of the prey in the web... No, the look of despair on the prey's face after it realizes its struggles are pointless is quite delightful, too.
units.displayText: The struggles of the prey in the web... No, the look of despair on the prey's face after it realizes its struggles are pointless is quite delightful, too.

spans.text: The struggles of the prey in the web... No, the look of despair on the prey's face after it realizes its struggles are pointless is quite delightful, too.

units.rawText: (She's vanished again... No, she hasn't vanished; she's using the terrain to hide herself.)
units.displayText: She's vanished again... No, she hasn't vanished; she's using the terrain to hide herself.

spans.text: She's vanished again... No, she hasn't vanished; she's using the terrain to hide herself.

units.rawText: (If I focus on her movements, I should be able to spot an opening...)
units.displayText: If I focus on her movements, I should be able to spot an opening...

spans.text: If I focus on her movements, I should be able to spot an opening...

units.rawText: Well? Have you found the answer to the riddle?
units.displayText: Well? Have you found the answer to the riddle?

spans.text: Well? Have you found the answer to the riddle?

units.rawText: Antenora's form flickers constantly throughout the cramped space, while Eos studies her every movement.
units.displayText: Antenora's form flickers constantly throughout the cramped space, while Eos studies her every movement.

spans.text: Antenora's form flickers constantly throughout the cramped space, while Eos studies her every movement.

units.rawText: —Got you!
units.displayText: —Got you!

spans.text: —Got you!

units.rawText: A meteor streaks out in the direction where Eos is pointing. It throws up a cloud of dust where it hits, creating an opportunity for escape.
units.displayText: A meteor streaks out in the direction where Eos is pointing. It throws up a cloud of dust where it hits, creating an opportunity for escape.

spans.text: A meteor streaks out in the direction where Eos is pointing. It throws up a cloud of dust where it hits, creating an opportunity for escape.

units.rawText: Whoa...
units.displayText: Whoa...

spans.text: Whoa...

units.rawText: <cmdr>, let's go!
units.displayText: {교수}, let's go!

spans.text: , let's go!

units.rawText: Well-played. Unfortunately, that was the wrong answer.
units.displayText: Well-played. Unfortunately, that was the wrong answer.

spans.text: Well-played. Unfortunately, that was the wrong answer.

units.rawText: Antenora suddenly appears beside us, and a sharp blade stabs into my side. The incredible pain forces me to my knees.
units.displayText: Antenora suddenly appears beside us, and a sharp blade stabs into my side. The incredible pain forces me to my knees.

spans.text: Antenora suddenly appears beside us, and a sharp blade stabs into my side. The incredible pain forces me to my knees.

units.rawText: <cmdr>!
units.displayText: {교수}!

units.rawText: Hehe...
units.displayText: Hehe...

spans.text: Hehe...

units.rawText: Antenora vanishes into the darkness again. It seems she is going to do what she said and toy with us until we die. Eos stands in front of me and warily surveys her surroundings, protecting us with a fragile, transparent barrier.
units.displayText: Antenora vanishes into the darkness again. It seems she is going to do what she said and toy with us until we die. Eos stands in front of me and warily surveys her surroundings, protecting us with a fragile, transparent barrier.

spans.text: Antenora vanishes into the darkness again. It seems she is going to do what she said and toy with us until we die. Eos stands in front of me and warily surveys her surroundings, protecting us with a fragile, transparent barrier.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, <cmdr>, it was my fault for being careless. This is her domain... She can freely control every part of it.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, {교수}, it was my fault for being careless. This is her domain... She can freely control every part of it.

spans.text: I'm sorry,
, it was my fault for being careless. This is her domain... She can freely control every part of it.

units.rawText: It's unrealistic to think we can escape in one piece... You should go, I'll delay her.
units.displayText: It's unrealistic to think we can escape in one piece... You should go, I'll delay her.

spans.text: It's unrealistic to think we can escape in one piece... You should go, I'll delay her.

units.rawText: No, I was analyzing the values of that exchange of yours just now... It's very likely that she can draw on the Watchtower's power, in addition to this entire region being a trap she set to catch us.
units.displayText: No, I was analyzing the values of that exchange of yours just now... It's very likely that she can draw on the Watchtower's power, in addition to this entire region being a trap she set to catch us.

spans.text: No, I was analyzing the values of that exchange of yours just now... It's very likely that she can draw on the Watchtower's power, in addition to this entire region being a trap she set to catch us.

units.rawText: Bingo! That's right~ The entire Watchtower is under my control. How about it? Are you going to keep struggling, or... will you be good and give up?
units.displayText: Bingo! That's right~ The entire Watchtower is under my control. How about it? Are you going to keep struggling, or... will you be good and give up?

spans.text: Bingo! That's right~ The entire Watchtower is under my control. How about it? Are you going to keep struggling, or... will you be good and give up?

units.rawText: Don't twist my words.
units.displayText: Don't twist my words.

spans.text: Don't twist my words.

units.rawText: You say this place is "under your control" ...But that's not entirely true, is it?
units.displayText: You say this place is "under your control" ...But that's not entirely true, is it?

spans.text: You say this place is "under your control" ...But that's not entirely true, is it?

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Both your movement patterns and your attack methods gave me a strong sense of deja vu...
units.displayText: Both your movement patterns and your attack methods gave me a strong sense of deja vu...

spans.text: Both your movement patterns and your attack methods gave me a strong sense of deja vu...

units.rawText: I take out the Rubik's Map.
units.displayText: I take out the Rubik's Map.

spans.text: I take out the Rubik's Map.

units.rawText: And now, I've figured out why.
units.displayText: And now, I've figured out why.

spans.text: And now, I've figured out why.

units.rawText: The fact that you managed to induce me to enter erroneous information into the Rubik's Map suggests that you're extremely familiar with its inner workings... Or rather, you know how the Tartarus Sector works like the back of your hand.
units.displayText: The fact that you managed to induce me to enter erroneous information into the Rubik's Map suggests that you're extremely familiar with its inner workings... Or rather, you know how the Tartarus Sector works like the back of your hand.

spans.text: The fact that you managed to induce me to enter erroneous information into the Rubik's Map suggests that you're extremely familiar with its inner workings... Or rather, you know how the Tartarus Sector works like the back of your hand.

units.rawText: It would be too difficult to erect a Watchtower out of nowhere in the Middle Ring. The truth is, only half of this is labyrinth terrain. The rest is just an illusion you crafted, right?
units.displayText: It would be too difficult to erect a Watchtower out of nowhere in the Middle Ring. The truth is, only half of this is labyrinth terrain. The rest is just an illusion you crafted, right?

spans.text: It would be too difficult to erect a Watchtower out of nowhere in the Middle Ring. The truth is, only half of this is labyrinth terrain. The rest is just an illusion you crafted, right?

units.rawText: Does that mean... the moving of the exit was caused by the labyrinth shifting?
units.displayText: Does that mean... the moving of the exit was caused by the labyrinth shifting?

spans.text: Does that mean... the moving of the exit was caused by the labyrinth shifting?

units.rawText: First, she deceived us with the actual terrain, and then she layered more and more illusions over it. You really worked hard on fine-tuning the right mixture of lies to truth.
units.displayText: First, she deceived us with the actual terrain, and then she layered more and more illusions over it. You really worked hard on fine-tuning the right mixture of lies to truth.

spans.text: First, she deceived us with the actual terrain, and then she layered more and more illusions over it. You really worked hard on fine-tuning the right mixture of lies to truth.

units.rawText: But unfortunately, I know the Rubik's Map very well, too.
units.displayText: But unfortunately, I know the Rubik's Map very well, too.

spans.text: But unfortunately, I know the Rubik's Map very well, too.

units.rawText: ...Prey which get smug over incorrect conclusions die sooner, you know.
units.displayText: ...Prey which get smug over incorrect conclusions die sooner, you know.

spans.text: ...Prey which get smug over incorrect conclusions die sooner, you know.

units.rawText: Oh, really? Then why aren't you pressing the attack right now?
units.displayText: Oh, really? Then why aren't you pressing the attack right now?

spans.text: Oh, really? Then why aren't you pressing the attack right now?

units.rawText: —Is it because the labyrinth is shifting again?
units.displayText: —Is it because the labyrinth is shifting again?

spans.text: —Is it because the labyrinth is shifting again?

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Two cannon blasts go off in front of me. I can feel Antenora's anger even through the operand barrier.
units.displayText: Two cannon blasts go off in front of me. I can feel Antenora's anger even through the operand barrier.

spans.text: Two cannon blasts go off in front of me. I can feel Antenora's anger even through the operand barrier.

units.rawText: Now, how should I reward you for seeing through my trap, <cmdr>... Hm...
units.displayText: Now, how should I reward you for seeing through my trap, {교수}... Hm...

spans.text: Now, how should I reward you for seeing through my trap,

units.rawText: I know! I'll sew your mouth shut and then perform a little craniotomy on you!
units.displayText: I know! I'll sew your mouth shut and then perform a little craniotomy on you!

spans.text: I know! I'll sew your mouth shut and then perform a little craniotomy on you!

units.rawText: Thanks, but no thanks! <cmdr>, we're going!
units.displayText: Thanks, but no thanks! {교수}, we're going!

spans.text: Thanks, but no thanks!
, we're going!

units.rawText: The exit's at 7 o'clock!
units.displayText: The exit's at 7 o'clock!

spans.text: The exit's at 7 o'clock!

units.rawText: Tsk... You know, it's really rude to ignore other people's preparations!
units.displayText: Tsk... You know, it's really rude to ignore other people's preparations!

spans.text: Tsk... You know, it's really rude to ignore other people's preparations!

units.rawText: We run toward the direction indicated by the Rubik's Map as the sound of Entropizing shells explode behind us again.
units.displayText: We run toward the direction indicated by the Rubik's Map as the sound of Entropizing shells explode behind us again.

spans.text: We run toward the direction indicated by the Rubik's Map as the sound of Entropizing shells explode behind us again.

units.rawText: (Antenora must have predesignated this entire area for Entropizing shell bombardments... This should be it.)
units.displayText: Antenora must have predesignated this entire area for Entropizing shell bombardments... This should be it.

spans.text: Antenora must have predesignated this entire area for Entropizing shell bombardments... This should be it.

units.rawText: Don't think you can get away.
units.displayText: Don't think you can get away.

spans.text: Don't think you can get away.

units.rawText: I tug on Eos to avoid the trajectory of the Entropizing shells and Antenora appears behind us again.
units.displayText: I tug on Eos to avoid the trajectory of the Entropizing shells and Antenora appears behind us again.

spans.text: I tug on Eos to avoid the trajectory of the Entropizing shells and Antenora appears behind us again.

units.rawText: She chops down with her blade-legs but they are blocked by meteoric brilliance.
units.displayText: She chops down with her blade-legs but they are blocked by meteoric brilliance.

spans.text: She chops down with her blade-legs but they are blocked by meteoric brilliance.

units.rawText: Don't forget about me...
units.displayText: Don't forget about me...

spans.text: Don't forget about me...

units.rawText: Guh... You're such a pain!
units.displayText: Guh... You're such a pain!

spans.text: Guh... You're such a pain!

units.rawText: The exit's just ahead, Eos!
units.displayText: The exit's just ahead, Eos!

spans.text: The exit's just ahead, Eos!

units.rawText: With spider webs, cannon fire, and blade-legs behind us, the light in front makes the illusion of the tower look like it's rippling.
units.displayText: With spider webs, cannon fire, and blade-legs behind us, the light in front makes the illusion of the tower look like it's rippling.

spans.text: With spider webs, cannon fire, and blade-legs behind us, the light in front makes the illusion of the tower look like it's rippling.

units.rawText: A bad feeling rises in my heart.
units.displayText: A bad feeling rises in my heart.

spans.text: A bad feeling rises in my heart.

units.rawText: <size=40>No! Eos, stop!</size>
units.displayText: No! Eos, stop!

spans.text: No! Eos, stop!

units.rawText: All I can do in the little time we have to react is shove Eos away. The illusion shatters and sticky, flowing Entropics flood in from the labyrinth's passages, but I am already in their midst.
units.displayText: All I can do in the little time we have to react is shove Eos away. The illusion shatters and sticky, flowing Entropics flood in from the labyrinth's passages, but I am already in their midst.

spans.text: All I can do in the little time we have to react is shove Eos away. The illusion shatters and sticky, flowing Entropics flood in from the labyrinth's passages, but I am already in their midst.

units.rawText: Devour.
units.displayText: Devour.

spans.text: Devour.

units.rawText: Disgusting lumps of purplish flesh detach from the walls and swallow me whole.
units.displayText: Disgusting lumps of purplish flesh detach from the walls and swallow me whole.

spans.text: Disgusting lumps of purplish flesh detach from the walls and swallow me whole.

units.rawText: Run... now...
units.displayText: Run... now...

spans.text: Run... now...

units.rawText: My final words are lost in the airtight, dark purple prison.
units.displayText: My final words are lost in the airtight, dark purple prison.

spans.text: My final words are lost in the airtight, dark purple prison.

units.rawText: Heehee, I was going to play with you for a while longer, but that final, touching scene was worth it.
units.displayText: Heehee, I was going to play with you for a while longer, but that final, touching scene was worth it.

spans.text: Heehee, I was going to play with you for a while longer, but that final, touching scene was worth it.

units.rawText: You won't run, will you, Eos?
units.displayText: You won't run, will you, Eos?

spans.text: You won't run, will you, Eos?

units.rawText: <cmdr>!!
Eos ignores Antenora's provocation. Instead, she gathers her operands and fires at the ever-swelling blob of Entropics, trying to save the person swallowed within.
units.displayText: Eos ignores Antenora's provocation. Instead, she gathers her operands and fires at the ever-swelling blob of Entropics, trying to save the person swallowed within.

spans.text: Eos ignores Antenora's provocation. Instead, she gathers her operands and fires at the ever-swelling blob of Entropics, trying to save the person swallowed within.

units.rawText: <cmdr>! Answer me if you're still conscious!
units.displayText: {교수}! Answer me if you're still conscious!

spans.text: ! Answer me if you're still conscious!

units.rawText: However, the starlight falls into a black hole, to no avail.
units.displayText: However, the starlight falls into a black hole, to no avail.

spans.text: However, the starlight falls into a black hole, to no avail.

units.rawText: Oh, what a stirring sight. Still, I can fulfill your wish to join them in death~
units.displayText: Oh, what a stirring sight. Still, I can fulfill your wish to join them in death~

spans.text: Oh, what a stirring sight. Still, I can fulfill your wish to join them in death~

units.rawText: Come and become my dinner together.
units.displayText: Come and become my dinner together.

spans.text: Come and become my dinner together.

units.rawText: Antenora's blade-legs thrust towards Eos. She struggles to avoid them while calling <cmdr>'s name.
units.displayText: Antenora's blade-legs thrust towards Eos. She struggles to avoid them while calling {교수}'s name.

spans.text: Antenora's blade-legs thrust towards Eos. She struggles to avoid them while calling
's name.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: Oh, how tragic. Even though you're a Greater Sanctifier, you're powerless before me.
units.displayText: Oh, how tragic. Even though you're a Greater Sanctifier, you're powerless before me.

spans.text: Oh, how tragic. Even though you're a Greater Sanctifier, you're powerless before me.

units.rawText: She no longer stabs with her sharp blade-legs, but turns to slap with them instead. Each strike lands accurately on Eos' wounds.
units.displayText: She no longer stabs with her sharp blade-legs, but turns to slap with them instead. Each strike lands accurately on Eos' wounds.

spans.text: She no longer stabs with her sharp blade-legs, but turns to slap with them instead. Each strike lands accurately on Eos' wounds.

units.rawText: (Winces)
units.displayText: Winces

spans.text: Winces

units.rawText: Yes, that's right. Are you mad? Are you frustrated? Are you scared?
units.displayText: Yes, that's right. Are you mad? Are you frustrated? Are you scared?

spans.text: Yes, that's right. Are you mad? Are you frustrated? Are you scared?

units.rawText: The feeling of slowly burying the light... truly, it is the most delicious seasoning for death.
units.displayText: The feeling of slowly burying the light... truly, it is the most delicious seasoning for death.

spans.text: The feeling of slowly burying the light... truly, it is the most delicious seasoning for death.

units.rawText: Antenora...
units.displayText: Antenora...

spans.text: Antenora...

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: The signal flare arrows in the distance drown out Eos' words as the light of the Sanctifier Watchtower gradually goes dark.
units.displayText: The signal flare arrows in the distance drown out Eos' words as the light of the Sanctifier Watchtower gradually goes dark.

spans.text: The signal flare arrows in the distance drown out Eos' words as the light of the Sanctifier Watchtower gradually goes dark.

units.rawText: Oh my, I didn't expect you to prepare fireworks for the occasion.
units.displayText: Oh my, I didn't expect you to prepare fireworks for the occasion.

spans.text: Oh my, I didn't expect you to prepare fireworks for the occasion.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Alcyone?!</color> But how...
units.displayText: Alcyone?! But how...

spans.text: Alcyone?!
But how...

units.rawText: All the Sanctifiers know what the arrows mean. They are a signal that was decided upon entering Tartarus.
units.displayText: All the Sanctifiers know what the arrows mean. They are a signal that was decided upon entering Tartarus.

spans.text: All the Sanctifiers know what the arrows mean. They are a signal that was decided upon entering Tartarus.

units.rawText: I guess that gift which I had Caina leave for you must have gone off. Ahhhh, if only I could have seen it.
units.displayText: I guess that gift which I had Caina leave for you must have gone off. Ahhhh, if only I could have seen it.

spans.text: I guess that gift which I had Caina leave for you must have gone off. Ahhhh, if only I could have seen it.

units.rawText: Those two Sanctifiers... What were their names, "Alcyone" and "Electra", was it? They ought to be killing each other around now.
units.displayText: Those two Sanctifiers... What were their names, "Alcyone" and "Electra", was it? They ought to be killing each other around now.

spans.text: Those two Sanctifiers... What were their names, "Alcyone" and "Electra", was it? They ought to be killing each other around now.

units.rawText: Antenora opens her hand, and a Seed of Entropization blossoms within it.
units.displayText: Antenora opens her hand, and a Seed of Entropization blossoms within it.

spans.text: Antenora opens her hand, and a Seed of Entropization blossoms within it.

units.rawText: I'm sure your despair would be so much richer if you could see it, too... What a shame.
units.displayText: I'm sure your despair would be so much richer if you could see it, too... What a shame.

spans.text: I'm sure your despair would be so much richer if you could see it, too... What a shame.

units.rawText: Aww, so sad you can't even bring yourself to speak? Poor dear.
units.displayText: Aww, so sad you can't even bring yourself to speak? Poor dear.

spans.text: Aww, so sad you can't even bring yourself to speak? Poor dear.

units.rawText: Still, that's alright. I'll send you to meet them right away!
units.displayText: Still, that's alright. I'll send you to meet them right away!

spans.text: Still, that's alright. I'll send you to meet them right away!

units.rawText: Antenora lunges at Eos again. Eos seems to be in the grip of her sorrow and stays still, quietly awaiting death.
units.displayText: Antenora lunges at Eos again. Eos seems to be in the grip of her sorrow and stays still, quietly awaiting death.

spans.text: Antenora lunges at Eos again. Eos seems to be in the grip of her sorrow and stays still, quietly awaiting death.

units.rawText: The blade-legs fall, and it is then that Antenora realizes that Eos' eyes are not filled with despair, but burning with anger.
units.displayText: The blade-legs fall, and it is then that Antenora realizes that Eos' eyes are not filled with despair, but burning with anger.

spans.text: The blade-legs fall, and it is then that Antenora realizes that Eos' eyes are not filled with despair, but burning with anger.

units.rawText: <cmdr>!
units.displayText: {교수}!

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: The purple prison explodes right next to Antenora. She reflexively dodges, but Eos immediately follows up with an attack.
units.displayText: The purple prison explodes right next to Antenora. She reflexively dodges, but Eos immediately follows up with an attack.

spans.text: The purple prison explodes right next to Antenora. She reflexively dodges, but Eos immediately follows up with an attack.

units.rawText: In a flash of starlight, two of Antenora's blade-legs are pulverized, and she crashes to the ground.
units.displayText: In a flash of starlight, two of Antenora's blade-legs are pulverized, and she crashes to the ground.

spans.text: In a flash of starlight, two of Antenora's blade-legs are pulverized, and she crashes to the ground.

units.rawText: Why...
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.rawText: As Eos approaches Antenora, more and more motes of starlight fall from the heavens, pulverizing the Entropics with their radiance.
units.displayText: As Eos approaches Antenora, more and more motes of starlight fall from the heavens, pulverizing the Entropics with their radiance.

spans.text: As Eos approaches Antenora, more and more motes of starlight fall from the heavens, pulverizing the Entropics with their radiance.

units.rawText: Eos.
units.displayText: Eos.

spans.text: Eos.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, Alcyone and Electra...
units.displayText: {교수}, Alcyone and Electra...

spans.text: , Alcyone and Electra...

units.rawText: Say no more.
units.displayText: Say no more.

spans.text: Say no more.

units.rawText: The two points of light representing Alcyone and Electra slowly vanish, and the Sanctifier Watchtower in the distance lights up again.
units.displayText: The two points of light representing Alcyone and Electra slowly vanish, and the Sanctifier Watchtower in the distance lights up again.

spans.text: The two points of light representing Alcyone and Electra slowly vanish, and the Sanctifier Watchtower in the distance lights up again.

units.rawText: ...They died to fulfil their mission as Sanctifiers. We can't let their sacrifice go to waste.
units.displayText: ...They died to fulfil their mission as Sanctifiers. We can't let their sacrifice go to waste.

spans.text: ...They died to fulfil their mission as Sanctifiers. We can't let their sacrifice go to waste.

units.rawText: Traps! Stop her!
units.displayText: Traps! Stop her!

spans.text: Traps! Stop her!

units.rawText: Antenora, you seem to enjoy the game of hunting others... don't you?
units.displayText: Antenora, you seem to enjoy the game of hunting others... don't you?

spans.text: Antenora, you seem to enjoy the game of hunting others... don't you?

units.rawText: The snares from her spider web spray out at Eos, but they evaporate before touching her.
units.displayText: The snares from her spider web spray out at Eos, but they evaporate before touching her.

spans.text: The snares from her spider web spray out at Eos, but they evaporate before touching her.

units.rawText: Still, you took the Greater Sanctifiers too lightly. How could a sacred Greater Sanctifier be reduced to a Daemon's prey?
units.displayText: Still, you took the Greater Sanctifiers too lightly. How could a sacred Greater Sanctifier be reduced to a Daemon's prey?

spans.text: Still, you took the Greater Sanctifiers too lightly. How could a sacred Greater Sanctifier be reduced to a Daemon's prey?

units.rawText: ?! So when you were attacking the Entropics just now...
units.displayText: ?! So when you were attacking the Entropics just now...

spans.text: ?! So when you were attacking the Entropics just now...

units.rawText: You said it before, didn't you? A hunter can't prepare enough when stalking their prey.
units.displayText: You said it before, didn't you? A hunter can't prepare enough when stalking their prey.

spans.text: You said it before, didn't you? A hunter can't prepare enough when stalking their prey.

units.rawText: You seem to think you know our abilities very well... But as a hunter, you ought to be prepared to become the hunted in turn.
units.displayText: You seem to think you know our abilities very well... But as a hunter, you ought to be prepared to become the hunted in turn.

spans.text: You seem to think you know our abilities very well... But as a hunter, you ought to be prepared to become the hunted in turn.

units.rawText: Now then, this is for Alcyone and Electra...
units.displayText: Now then, this is for Alcyone and Electra...

spans.text: Now then, this is for Alcyone and Electra...

units.rawText: Eos stops and looks at Antenora's frightened face.
units.displayText: Eos stops and looks at Antenora's frightened face.

spans.text: Eos stops and looks at Antenora's frightened face.

units.rawText: <cmdr>.
units.displayText: {교수}.

options.rawText: Show her what a real Sanctifier is like, Eos.
options.displayText: Show her what a real Sanctifier is like, Eos.

spans.text: Show her what a real Sanctifier is like, Eos.
